newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Philippines seeks more aggressive export strategy.
newsitem.headline: Philippines seeks more aggressive export strategy.

text.p: The Philippines' National Economic and Development Authority (Neda) has recommended the adoption of a more aggressive export strategy to sustain the country's strong economic growth, a government statement said.

In a report to President Fidel Ramos, Socio-economic Planning Minister and Neda director general Cielito Habito pushed for the implementation of a well-defined export marketing strategy to uphold economic gains, a statement released by the presidential palace on Saturday said.
It did not give details of the exports strategy.

But Habito said the government should ensure that public infrastructure projects are on stream, and called for scrutiny of the garment and rubber manufacturing industries to see whether they can be revived.
Garment exports are among the Philippines' top dollar earners. -- Manila newsroom 63 2 8418939 fax 8176267
